party.name: Oren Reed
party.summary: Cleric · Level 1. Protect the party with Bless and a shield. Sacred Flame attacks at range; Cure Wounds and Healing Word restore allies.
party.profile:
# Oren Reed

Human Cleric, level 1. Pronouns: they/them.

Patient and practical; asks what would help before offering advice. No fixed home, allegiance, or campaign history is assigned.

## Playing Oren

Protect the party with Bless and a shield. Sacred Flame attacks at range; Cure Wounds and Healing Word restore allies. Divine Order: Protector.

## Creation choices

Standard array, then the Acolyte background increases, is reflected in the final ability scores. Acolyte supplies its listed skills, tool, and origin feat. Human Versatile supplies Skilled; Skillful supplies perception. Skilled choices: history survival athletics. Class skill choices: medicine persuasion. Starting equipment uses class option A and background option A, with 15 GP retained. Also carried, at no cost: two lodestones for Mending. Languages: Common, Dwarvish, and Elvish. Human Resourceful grants Heroic Inspiration after a Long Rest.

All identity, personality, background, ability, equipment, skill, and spell choices can be changed on an independent copy. Keep the declared creation rules when changing mechanical choices.
